summary: Configured /tmp and /dev/shm on node1 as tmpfs mounts with noexec,nosuid,nodev via /etc/fstab, verified enforcement live and after a full reboot (boot_id changed, confirming genuine restart), and confirmed system health post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline fstab and mount state for /tmp and /dev/shm on node1
Backed up /etc/fstab and appended tmpfs entries for /tmp and /dev/shm with options defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev
Ran systemctl daemon-reload, remounted /dev/shm, and mounted /tmp live to apply changes without reboot
Verified noexec enforcement by attempting to execute a script placed in /tmp (denied, exit 126)
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and system health (systemctl is-system-running)
Triggered systemctl reboot on node1 via a backgrounded delayed command so the exec ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed post-restart, proving an actual reboot occurred
Verified /tmp and /dev/shm still mounted as tmpfs with noexec,nosuid,nodev after reboot, and tmp.mount is active
Re-verified system health and noexec enforcement on both /tmp and /dev/shm post-reboot with fresh executable scripts (both denied, exit 126)

evidence.requirement: /tmp and /dev/shm mounted with noexec,nosuid,nodev, persisted via fstab
evidence.summary: Baseline showed /tmp not separately mounted and /dev/shm lacking noexec; added fstab tmpfs entries with defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev for both, applied live via daemon-reload/remount/mount, and findmnt confirmed both options active

evidence.requirement: Functional proof that execution is blocked on /tmp and /dev/shm
evidence.summary: Attempted to execute chmod +x scripts placed in /tmp and /dev/shm; both denied with exit code 126 before and after reboot
Captured pre-restart boot_id (5fb1b173-...) and systemctl is-system-running=running

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded delayed systemctl reboot command returned 'reboot_scheduled' acknowledgement immediately, then subsequent exec calls failed with connection reset confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Polled node1 through connection resets until exec succeeded again; boot_id changed from 5fb1b173-... to 4000662d-f97a-45f9-8a00-178d5d4be10f, proving a genuine reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 recovered state: mounts persisted and system healthy after restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart findmnt confirmed /tmp and /dev/shm still tmpfs with noexec,nosuid,nodev and tmp.mount active; systemctl is-system-running=running; functional noexec test repeated successfully
